findingDetails.title: Series-parent creation recipe names a scaffold command that produces the wrong structure, and an append command that fails
findingDetails.claim: The recipe (scaffold the parent with create.sh --phase) selects phased-packet mode, which scaffolds a parent plus PHASE_COUNT children (default 3), colliding with the move-as-child-001 and add-child-002 steps; create.sh --phase --parent omits the required path value; the parent-focused scaffold mode is --level phase-parent.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched create.sh for a --phase mode yielding a parent-only scaffold (none; default 3 children). Checked --level phase-parent (parent + placeholder child 001-validation-phase-PROVIDE-DESCRIPTIVE-SLUG). Checked for an alternate series-parent recipe (none).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence may be prose shorthand and an operator may delete scaffolded children by hand; but the named flag selects a different mode and the placeholder replacement remains unstated.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If maintainers treat section 2 as an informal outline or change create.sh --phase semantics to parent-only, downgrade to P2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Diff sweep of the four 006 commits found no other new command instruction; create.sh usage and call sites read directly.
findingDetails.recommendation: Name create.sh --level phase-parent for the parent scaffold (or --phase --phases 1 --phase-names <slug> when a real first child is intended), state how the placeholder child is replaced, and pass explicit arguments on the remaining commands (--parent <path>, repair-derived.cjs --folder <packet> --apply, refresh-track-roots.mjs --track <track> --apply).

findingDetails.title: REQ-002 no-doc-still-says-Option-E is not met: skill README still teaches Option E
findingDetails.claim: The Gate 3 flow diagram still shows Option E: Skip documentation, while AGENTS.md defines A/B/C/D with D = Skip and commit 6a21c6b5311 renamed the skip option everywhere it edited. AC-002 evidence narrows the search to the edited docs; REQ-002 says no doc.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Swept .skilled excluding changelogs: remaining hits are the README diagram, historical changelog entries, a benchmark log, and test OR-conditions that accept alternate strings. Checked Out of Scope: only the global CLAUDE.md is exempted. Checked whether README is generated: no generator found.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The diagram is a simplified intro (it never listed C or D) and the intended doc set may have been the rule docs; that does not satisfy the unconditional no-doc wording.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If maintainers scope the requirement to the edited docs (AC-002 reading), downgrade to P2 and correct the requirement wording.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Repo-wide search for Option E performed; stale copies classified (live README vs historical changelogs vs test expectations).
findingDetails.recommendation: Change the diagram label to Option D: Skip documentation or drop the option from the simplified diagram and point at the AGENTS.md gate; rerun a repo-wide Option E search.

findingDetails.title: REQ-003 every-doc-restating-thresholds is not met: two reference docs restate both thresholds with no series-parent exception
findingDetails.claim: level-selection-guide.md line 83 and level-specifications.md phase-detection section (lines 786-790) restate the qualification rule without the exception and contain zero series-parent mentions; AC-003 evidence names only the seven rule docs.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Confirmed both lines are qualification restatements, not scoring tables; confirmed the files are not in Files to Change (sweep scoped there); the authoring-checklist miss of the same class was treated as must-fix in the packet history.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The intended doc set may be the seven rule docs; then the correct fix is narrowing REQ-003/AC-003 rather than adding text.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Requirement scope clarified to the seven rule docs, then P2.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Threshold-wording search across the skill tree with per-file series-parent counts (7 of 9 docs carry the exception).
findingDetails.recommendation: Add the one-line exception beside both restatements, or explicitly scope REQ-003 to the rule docs in both REQ and AC text.

findingDetails.title: quick-reference section 9 Option C description omits the series parent that AGENTS.md includes
findingDetails.claim: Section 9 Option C describes packet/child/decomposition but not the series parent, while the same doc priority line (272) and the AGENTS.md label include it.
findingDetails.recommendation: Mirror the series-parent clause into the section 9 Option C line.

findingDetails.title: New judge class template-default missing from the retrieval conventions class list
findingDetails.claim: The Warn On list enumerates eight judge classes but not template-default, which the judge now returns; the list documents the GREP_CONVENTION warning vocabulary.
findingDetails.recommendation: Add template-default to the Warn On list with its meaning.

findingDetails.recommendation: Fill the counts or remove the placeholder table.
